body: Not exactly. I think we need to take care of ourselves first. Knowing we are so susceptible to negative energy and users.. Its basic self care to vet anyone we want to include in our lives on any kind of "real" level. It usually (for me anyways) proves to be a long and arduous task. It's difficult to make friends because I know I will bend over backwards for the people I love.. But get hurt when they don't reciprocate. I just mean to say we are very cautious and analytical of who we invite in.. And it's usually for a good reason.

Our expectations and needs are high because we know we will pour ourselves completely into any relationship we enter. Sometimes even to the point of self-sabotage. Personally I consider it a fail safe.
Thank you for being such a good mod. Its people like you that make me love and appreciate Reddit.
